name: dev-loop
description: Status line for a local dev loop: which ports are up, and which folder (desk, worktree) serves each, so parallel sessions know whose server they are hitting.

ports.title: Ports
ports.description: Comma-separated port:label pairs to watch, e.g. 3000:web,8080:api. Empty shows nothing.

roots.title: Folders
roots.description: Comma-separated folders (absolute, or relative to your home) whose sessions show the line. Empty shows it everywhere.
